title: Wizard Cat and Skeleton Jester
description: A whimsical scene shows a round, orange cat dressed as a wizard with a pointed hat and long beard, sitting on a large golden orb. A golden skeleton in a jester-like pose balances a glowing, multicolored disco ball on one finger while standing on a stone path.
prompt: A cheerful round orange cat wizard with a long beard and pointed hat sits atop a large glowing golden orb. Beside him, a tall golden skeleton in jester pose balances a sparkling multicolored disco ball on its finger. They are in a sunlit Mediterranean courtyard with ancient stone arches, cascading purple and pink flowers, yellow blossoms, and a giant golden planet in the bright sky, whimsical watercolor painting style.
